sources.source: Crown Prosecution Service Annual Report and Accounts 2025-2026
sources.verified_fact: The official report was ordered to be printed on 14 July 2026 and includes audited accounts together with an annex of casework statistics for the 2025 to 2026 reporting year.
sources.quality_effect: Adds prosecution-system performance context while retaining case-versus-defendant, charge-versus-prosecution, completed-versus-received case, conviction, offence-mix and no-crime-incidence substitution guards.

sources.source: HM Courts & Tribunals Service annual report and accounts 2025 to 2026
sources.verified_fact: The report was published on 9 July 2026 and covers performance, spending, vision, objectives, priorities, staffing and governance for 1 April 2025 to 31 March 2026.
sources.quality_effect: Adds court-and-tribunal service capacity context while retaining workload-versus-person, receipts-versus-disposals, backlog, timeliness, jurisdiction and service-output-versus-justice-outcome guards.

sources.source: Director of Legal Aid Casework annual report 2025 to 2026
sources.verified_fact: The official report covers 1 April 2025 to 31 March 2026 and explains the Director of Legal Aid Casework role, casework independence and its relationship to Legal Aid Agency application reporting.
sources.quality_effect: Adds legal-aid decision-governance context while retaining application-versus-person, grant-versus-case, civil-versus-criminal scope, delegated decision and annual-report-versus-detailed-statistics guards.

sources.source: Government Legal Department Annual Report and Accounts 2025-26
sources.verified_fact: Published on 18 June 2026, the report integrates performance and financial data for Government Legal Department activity from 1 April 2025 to 31 March 2026.
sources.quality_effect: Adds government legal-service capacity context while retaining advice-versus-litigation, client-department, case-volume, legal-spend, staffing and corporate-performance-versus-public-outcome guards.

sources.source: Criminal Cases Review Commission Annual Report 2025/26
sources.verified_fact: The Commission announced publication of its annual report on 14 July 2026 and reported receiving 1,841 applications in 2025/26, almost 20% more than in the previous year.
sources.quality_effect: Adds potential-miscarriage review demand context while retaining application-versus-applicant, review-versus-referral, referral-versus-quashed-conviction, custody status and no-prevalence-inference guards.

sources.source: HM Crown Prosecution Service Inspectorate Annual Report 2025-26
sources.verified_fact: The Inspectorate's official reports library lists its Annual Report 2025-26 alongside current inspection reports and its 2026/27 business plan.
sources.quality_effect: Adds independent prosecution-inspection context while retaining inspection-versus-organisation, sample-versus-universe, recommendation-versus-implementation and no-prosecution-outcome substitution guards.

sources.source: UK Statistics Authority annual report and accounts 2025/2026
sources.verified_fact: The official annual report and accounts was published on 9 July 2026 and provides the Authority's corporate and financial reporting for 2025/26.
sources.quality_effect: Adds national-statistical-system governance context while retaining corporate-activity-versus-data-quality, producer-versus-regulator role, revision and no-source-specific-quality assumption guards.

sources.source: Office for Statistics Regulation Annual Report 2025/26
sources.verified_fact: The regulator's official annual report describes 2025/26 casework, guidance and public interventions intended to support transparent and trustworthy communication of statistics.
sources.quality_effect: Adds statistical-misuse and regulatory-intervention context while retaining casework-versus-incident, intervention-versus-correction, producer scope and no-misuse-prevalence inference guards.

sources.source: Valuation Office Agency annual report and accounts 2025 to 2026
sources.authority: Valuation Office Agency and HM Revenue & Customs
sources.verified_fact: The report was published on 9 July 2026 for activity from April 2025 to March 2026 and records that the Valuation Office Agency became part of HMRC on 1 April 2026.
sources.quality_effect: Adds valuation-system and organisational-transition context while retaining valuation-list-versus-property, case-versus-hereditament, appeal, transaction and pre/post-reorganisation guards.

sources.source: Standards and Testing Agency annual report and accounts 2025 to 2026
sources.verified_fact: Published on 13 July 2026, the report covers the year ended 31 March 2026 and the agency's role in developing and delivering assessments from reception to the end of key stage 2 in England.
sources.quality_effect: Adds school-assessment delivery context while retaining test-versus-pupil, cohort, participation, administration-versus-attainment, assessment-change and England-only scope guards.

sources.source: Nuclear Decommissioning Authority Annual Report and Accounts 2025 to 2026
sources.verified_fact: Published on 16 July 2026, the report describes progress in hazard reduction, civil-nuclear-site decommissioning, radioactive-waste management, transport, safety, security and environmental performance.
sources.quality_effect: Adds civil-nuclear decommissioning context while retaining programme-versus-incident, site, waste-package unit, hazard reduction, transport and no-local-current-risk substitution guards.

sources.source: UKAEA Annual Report and Accounts 2025 to 2026
sources.verified_fact: Published on 16 July 2026, the report covers UKAEA activities, financial performance, resources, achievements and goals for 1 April 2025 to 31 March 2026.
sources.quality_effect: Adds fusion-research capability context while retaining research-versus-commercial operation, facility, experiment, programme milestone and no-operational-nuclear-risk inference guards.

sources.source: UK Space Agency Annual Report and Accounts 2025-2026
sources.verified_fact: The official report was published and laid before the House of Commons on 14 July 2026 for the 2025 to 2026 financial year.
sources.quality_effect: Adds space-programme governance context while retaining grant-versus-project, mission-versus-launch, regulatory-role separation and no-launch-safety-outcome inference guards.

sources.source: Government Commercial Agency annual report and accounts 2025 to 2026
sources.authority: Government Commercial Agency and Crown Commercial Service
sources.verified_fact: Published on 15 July 2026, the report describes Crown Commercial Service activity in 2025/26; Government Commercial Agency was formed on 1 April 2026 by combining CCS with Cabinet Office commercial teams.
sources.quality_effect: Adds procurement-system governance context while retaining predecessor-versus-successor, framework-versus-contract, spend-versus-saving, supplier-versus-award and reporting-period guards.

sources.source: Government Property Agency Annual Report and Accounts 2025 to 2026
sources.verified_fact: The official at-a-glance report was updated on 13 July 2026 and reviews progress toward a smaller, better and greener government office estate during 2025/26.
sources.quality_effect: Adds government-estate delivery context while retaining estate-versus-building, project-versus-completion, office-versus-public estate, sustainability-versus-safety and no-occupant-risk inference guards.

sources.source: Homes England Annual Report and Accounts 2025 to 2026
sources.verified_fact: Published on 15 July 2026, the report covers Homes England's financial year from 1 April 2025 to 31 March 2026.
sources.quality_effect: Adds housing-and-regeneration delivery context while retaining investment-versus-home, permission-versus-completion, programme, partner, geography and no-property-safety-score guards.

sources.source: Planning Inspectorate Annual Report and Accounts 2025/26
sources.verified_fact: Published on 25 June 2026, the report records 19,600 decisions, permission on appeal for 23,000 homes and a reduction in the open appeals caseload from about 11,400 to 9,400; live administrative figures can be revised.
sources.quality_effect: Adds planning-service timeliness context while retaining decision-versus-site, permission-versus-home-built, open-caseload snapshot, appeal type, revision and no-parcel-outcome guards.

sources.source: Rural Payments Agency annual report and accounts 2025 to 2026
sources.verified_fact: Published on 9 July 2026, the report covers performance from 1 April 2025 to 31 March 2026 and the agency's role in direct aid and rural-development payments to farmers in England.
sources.quality_effect: Adds rural-support administration context while retaining payment-versus-recipient, farm-versus-holding, land-parcel, scheme, eligibility and payment-versus-rural-outcome guards.

sources.source: Office for Budget Responsibility annual report and accounts 2025 to 2026
sources.verified_fact: Published on 25 June 2026, the report covers the OBR's budget, finances, achievements, staffing structure and operations, with accounts audited by the National Audit Office.
sources.quality_effect: Adds fiscal-institution governance context while retaining corporate-performance-versus-forecast-accuracy, forecast-versus-outturn, scenario, revision, economic-cycle and no-local-risk guards.

sources.source: The Pensions Regulator Annual Report and Accounts 2025/2026
sources.verified_fact: The regulator's official announcement accompanying the report states that around 22 million people save into workplace pensions and approximately £1.8 trillion of assets are under management.
sources.quality_effect: Adds pension-system scale and supervisory context while retaining saver-versus-account, asset-stock-versus-flow, scheme type, self-reported asset value and supervision-versus-compliance guards.

quality_guards: AREA_LEVEL_PROXY only; no parcel measurement claim.
Justice-system annual reports use cases, defendants, applications, decisions and referrals as distinct units.
Corporate reports describe institutional activity and finances rather than population harm, crime or safety prevalence.
Inspection findings, recommendations and interventions depend on sample, scope, jurisdiction and publication period.
Statistical-system governance does not establish the accuracy of every underlying source or release.
Education assessment administration and pupil attainment are different concepts and cohorts.
Nuclear decommissioning, fusion research and space-programme activity do not directly measure local operational risk.
Procurement and property-agency outputs use predecessor, project, framework, estate and reporting-period units.
Housing investment, planning permission and completed homes are not interchangeable.
Rural payments, holdings and land parcels use different units and eligibility rules.
Pension savers, accounts, schemes and assets under management are not interchangeable.
